validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real and correctly classified. This is a small compressor-only expansion (FERC docket CP22-181, 'Applied' in EIA's Oct-2022 release, 'Completed' 2022-09-30 in every EIA release from Jan-2023 on) of Carolina Gas Transmission LLC's interstate system, adding 10 MMcf/d via new/modified compression at the Moore (Spartanburg Co.) and new Dorchester Co. compressor stations to serve an LDC delivery point in Charleston, SC — cost $5.5M, no new pipe (miles blank in EIA, consistent with the sheet's LengthKnown=0). Independently corroborated by Carolina Gas Transmission's own August 2025 South Carolina PSC company-overview filing (docket ND-2025-52-G), whose 'CGT Contracted Capacity and Expansions' chronology lists a single 2022 entry: 'Compressor Modifications, 10,000 Dt' — no mileage, matching the EIA docket exactly by year + nature + volume (10,000 Dth/d ≈ 10 MMcf/d) even though the PSC deck doesn't use the FERC project name. Two independent origins (EIA/FERC docket vs. Carolina Gas Transmission's own SC PSC regulatory filing), high confidence. DUPLICATE: checked against all 40 sibling rows on the roster — no overlap; this is CGT's only 2022 FERC-dockets project on the roster, distinct from CGT's other GEM rows (P4381 Columbia-to-Eastover, P4382 Transco to Charleston — not in this batch's roster) and from the unrelated, earlier (2016 filing, ~2017-18 in-service, ~$119M, 55+5 mi of new pipe) Moore/Dorchester/Southern compressor-station work under the 'Transco to Charleston Project' — that is a different, larger, already-tracked project, not this one. SPEC concern: Status is stale (sheet says 'proposed', LastUpdated 2022-09-30) — evidence shows the project was completed and placed in service 2022-09-30, i.e. operating since 2022, matching the sheet's own (uncited) StartYear1=2022. Full status change detailed in status_reviews.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet's LastUpdated (2022-09-30) is the same day EIA records this project as Completed/in-service — the sheet was simply never updated past 'proposed' once the project closed out. EIA's Historical Projects sheet (present unchanged from the Jan-2023 release through the current Aug-2026 release) shows: Status=Completed, Completed Date=2022-09-30, Year In Service=2022, docket CP22-181. Independently, Carolina Gas Transmission's own August 2025 South Carolina PSC company-overview filing (docket ND-2025-52-G) lists, in its capacity-expansion history chart, a single 2022 entry — 'Compressor Modifications, 10,000 Dt' — with no other 2022 entries, matching the EIA docket's year, nature (compression, no new mileage) and volume (10,000 Dth/d ≈ 10 MMcf/d). No newer evidence suggests the project was later abandoned, idled, or reversed — it is a small, permanent compression addition to CGT's long-operating mainline. Recommend Status -> operating; StartYear1 (already 2022 on the sheet, previously uncited) is now sourced by the same evidence.
